---
title: Graph Queries in DataONE Solr
---

Note: the operations desribed here require Solr >= 8.x so do not work on the current production CNs. Instead, Arcticdata.io is used for the examples.

```{ojs}
//| code-fold: true

async function makeSolrRequest(q, fl="id,formatId,resourceMap", rows=100, debugQuery=false) {
    const solrUrl = "https://arcticdata.io/metacat/d1/mn/v2/query/solr/";
    const url = new URL(solrUrl);
    url.searchParams.append("fl", fl);
    url.searchParams.append("rows", rows);
    url.searchParams.append("wt", "json");
    url.searchParams.append("debugQuery", debugQuery);
    url.searchParams.append("q", q);
    const response = await fetch(url, {
        method: "GET",
        headers: {"Accept":"application/json"}
    });
    console.log(response.url);
    return await response.json();
}

function SOLRencode(value) {
  const specials = ['+', '-', '&', '!', '(', ')', '{', '}', '[', ']', '^', '"', '~', '*', '?', ':', '\\'];
  const regexp = new RegExp("(\\" + specials.join("|\\") + ")", "g");
  let v = value.replace(regexp, "\\$1");
  if (v != value) {
    return '"' + v + '"';
  }
  return v;
}

async function getPIDResourceMaps(pid) {
    const q = `{!graph from=id to=resourceMap traversalFilter='(*:* AND -obsoletedBy:*)' returnOnlyLeaf=true}(id:${SOLRencode(pid)})`;
    const fl = "id,formatId,resourceMap,obsoletedBy,obsoletes";
    const response = await makeSolrRequest(q, fl);
    console.log(response);
    if (response === undefined) {
        return ["ERROR: undefined response."];
    }
    if (response.response.numFound < 1) {
        return [`ERROR: no resource maps found for PID: ${pid}`];
    }
    const resource_maps = [];    
    for (const entry of response.response.docs) {
        resource_maps.push(entry.id);
    }
    return resource_maps;
}


async function resourceMapsResult(pid) {
    const result = await getPIDResourceMaps(pid);
    return result.map((item) => {
            return {"resourcemap":item}
        });
}

async function getResourcemapEntries(pid) {
    const q = `{!graph to=id from=resourceMap traversalFilter='(*:* AND -obsoletedBy:*)' maxDepth=10}(id:${SOLRencode(pid)})`
    const fl = "id,formatId,resourceMap,obsoletedBy,obsoletes";
    const response = await makeSolrRequest(q, fl, 1000);
    console.log(response);
    if (response === undefined) {
        return ["ERROR: undefined response."];
    }

    const nodes = [];
    const edges = [];
    const _keys = [];
    for (const doc of response.response.docs) {
        nodes.push({
            "pid": doc.id,
            "group": doc.formatId,
            "resourceMap": doc.resourceMap
        });
        _keys.push(doc.id)
    };
    for (const doc of response.response.docs) {
        if (doc.resourceMap) {
            for (const ore of doc.resourceMap) {
                if (_keys.includes(ore)) {
                    edges.push({"source": doc.id, "target": ore})
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return {
        "nodes":nodes, 
        "links":edges
    };
}
```

```{ojs}

    {

        header:{"resourcemap":"Resource Maps"},

```


```{ojs}
//| code-fold: true
graphdata = {
    return await getResourcemapEntries(resourcemap_pids.resourcemap);
};
viewof nodetable = Inputs.table(graphdata.nodes);
```

```{ojs}
//| code-fold: true

selected_node = Inputs.text({label:"Clicked Node", value:"", width:"100%"})

function setSelected(v) {
  selected_node.value = v;
}

ForceGraph3D = require("//cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/3d-force-graph");

Graph3 = new ForceGraph3D(document.getElementById('3d-graph'))
      .width(800)
      .height(800)
      .graphData(graphdata)
      .nodeAutoColorBy('group')
      .nodeLabel((node) => {return node.pid})
      .onNodeClick((node) => {
        setSelected(node.pid);
      });
```

<div id="2d-graph"></div>

```{ojs}
ForceGraph = require("//cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/force-graph");

Graph = new ForceGraph(document.getElementById('2d-graph'))
        .graphData(graphdata)
        .nodeId("pid")
        .width(800)
        .height(800)
        .nodeAutoColorBy('group')
        .nodeCanvasObject((node, ctx, globalScale) => {
          const label = node.pid;
          const fontSize = 12/globalScale;
          ctx.font = `${fontSize}px Sans-Serif`;
          const textWidth = ctx.measureText(label).width;
          const bckgDimensions = [textWidth, fontSize].map(n => n + fontSize * 0.2); // some padding

          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)';
          ctx.fillRect(node.x - bckgDimensions[0] / 2, node.y - bckgDimensions[1] / 2, ...bckgDimensions);

          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
          ctx.fillStyle = node.color;
          ctx.fillText(label, node.x, node.y);

          node.__bckgDimensions = bckgDimensions; // to re-use in nodePointerAreaPaint
        })
        .nodePointerAreaPaint((node, color, ctx) => {
          ctx.fillStyle = color;
          const bckgDimensions = node.__bckgDimensions;
          bckgDimensions && ctx.fillRect(node.x - bckgDimensions[0] / 2, node.y - bckgDimensions[1] / 2, ...bckgDimensions);
        });
```


```{ojs}
//| code-fold: true

chart = {
    // Specify the dimensions of the chart.
    const width = 928;
    const height = 928;

    // Specify the color scale.
    const color = d3.scaleOrdinal(d3.schemeCategory10);

    // The force simulation mutates links and nodes, so create a copy
    // so that re-evaluating this cell produces the same result.
    const links = graphdata.links.map(d => ({...d}));
    const nodes = graphdata.nodes.map(d => ({...d}));

    // Create a simulation with several forces.
    const simulation = d3.forceSimulation(nodes)
        .force("link", d3.forceLink(links).id(d => d.pid))
        .force("charge", d3.forceManyBody())
        .force("center", d3.forceCenter(width / 2, height / 2))
        .on("tick", ticked);

    // Create the SVG container.
    const svg = d3.create("svg")
        .attr("width", width)
        .attr("height", height)
        .attr("viewBox", [0, 0, width, height])
        .attr("style", "max-width: 100%; height: auto;");

  // Add a line for each link, and a circle for each node.
    const link = svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "#999")
        .attr("stroke-opacity", 0.6)
        .selectAll()
        .data(links)
        .join("line")
        .attr("stroke-width", d => Math.sqrt(d.value));

    const zoomRect = svg.append("rect")
        .attr("width", width)
        .attr("height", height)
        .style("fill", "none")
        .style("pointer-events", "all")

    const node = svg.append("g")
        .attr("stroke", "#fff")
        .attr("stroke-width", 1.5)
        .selectAll()
        .data(nodes)
        .join("circle")
        .attr("r", 5)
        .attr("fill", d => color(d.group));

    node.append("title")
        .text(d => d.id);

    // Add a drag behavior.
    node.call(d3.drag()
            .on("start", dragstarted)
            .on("drag", dragged)
            .on("end", dragended));

    // Set the position attributes of links and nodes each time the simulation ticks.
    function ticked() {
        link
            .attr("x1", d => d.source.x)
            .attr("y1", d => d.source.y)
            .attr("x2", d => d.target.x)
            .attr("y2", d => d.target.y);

        node
            .attr("cx", d => d.x)
            .attr("cy", d => d.y);
    }

    const zoom = d3.zoom()
        .scaleExtent([1, 8])
        //.scaleExtent([1/2, 64])
        .on("zoom", zoom_actions);

    zoomRect.call(zoom)
        .call(zoom.translateTo, 0, 0);


    // Reheat the simulation when drag starts, and fix the subject position.
    function dragstarted(event) {
        if (!event.active) simulation.alphaTarget(0.3).restart();
        event.subject.fx = event.subject.x;
        event.subject.fy = event.subject.y;
    }

    // Update the subject (dragged node) position during drag.
    function dragged(event) {
        event.subject.fx = event.x;
        event.subject.fy = event.y;
    }

    // Restore the target alpha so the simulation cools after dragging ends.
    // Unfix the subject position now that it’s no longer being dragged.
    function dragended(event) {
        if (!event.active) simulation.alphaTarget(0);
        event.subject.fx = null;
        event.subject.fy = null;
    }

    function zoom_actions({transform}){
        console.log(`zoom action ${transform}`);
        zoomRect.attr("transform", transform)
        node.attr("transform", transform);
        link.attr("transform", transform);
    }

    // When this cell is re-run, stop the previous simulation. (This doesn’t
    // really matter since the target alpha is zero and the simulation will
    // stop naturally, but it’s a good practice.)
    invalidation.then(() => simulation.stop());

    return svg.node();
}
```
